---
title: "Teaching with the slides"
---

You are welcome to teach with these slides, in whole or in part, and to adapt them for your own
course.

## Materials for instructors

Problem sets with solutions, worksheet solutions, and past exams are available to instructors on
request. Please email [yiqingxu@stanford.edu](mailto:yiqingxu@stanford.edu) from your institutional
address, name the course you teach, and do not post the solutions publicly.

## Building and adapting the slides

Each lecture's folder in the [repository](https://github.com/xuyiqing/regression-lectures) holds
the LaTeX Beamer source, the figures, the R scripts that draw them, and the data the scripts read.
All lectures share one template, `lectures/course_preamble.tex` and `lectures/course_theme.tex`,
and every R script uses the shared figure style in `lectures/course_figures.R`. You need TeX Live
2023 or later and R 4.x. The
[README](https://github.com/xuyiqing/regression-lectures#readme) has the build commands.

## Corrections

Comments and corrections are welcome as
[issues](https://github.com/xuyiqing/regression-lectures/issues) on GitHub.
